source_evidence: Some advisers only offer proprietary investment products. Cancellation may require the sale of some (or all) of the investments held in your account.
question: What might happen to investments in an account when you cancel an advisory agreement with an adviser that offers only proprietary products?
answer: Cancellation may require selling some or all of the investments in your account. Check whether you can transfer the investments to an account that is not managed by the adviser.
